shots.title: Midnight pacing
shots.words: Marcus paced circles around his coffee table at midnight,

shots.title: Desperate calculation
shots.words: desperate for twenty-six hundred more steps.

shots.title: Watch red ring
shots.words: His smart watch flashed a mocking red ring.

shots.title: Only ten thousand saves
shots.words: Seven thousand was not enough; only the holy ten thousand could save him.

shots.title: Marching past cat
shots.words: He marched past his sleeping cat.

shots.title: Toothbrush high knees
shots.words: He did frantic high knees while brushing his teeth.

shots.title: Midnight toe stub collapse
shots.words: At midnight, Marcus stubbed his toe and collapsed onto the rug.

shots.title: Plus two steps registered
shots.words: Luckily, his tracker registered the crash as two extra steps.

shots.title: Clock salesman reveal
shots.words: Unluckily, the entire target was invented by a clock salesman.

shots.title: Not a medical prescription
shots.words: You see, ten thousand was never a medical prescription.

shots.title: Manpo-kei 1965 launch
shots.words: In nineteen sixty-five, a Japanese company launched the Manpo-kei pedometer.

shots.title: Walking kanji character
shots.words: They chose ten thousand because the Japanese character looks like a walking person.

shots.title: Advertising gimmick
shots.words: It was an advertising gimmick, not biology.

shots.title: Harvard longevity curve
shots.words: Harvard studies show longevity benefits level off around seventy-five hundred steps.

shots.title: Stealing your sleep
shots.words: Pushing past that doesn't add years; it just steals your sleep.
